creative_direction: Depict Nami with her familiar orange hair and an opaque pale-orange jacket over a simple striped crew-neck shirt. Use warm ivory paper and compact brush shapes, avoiding revealing clothing, exaggerated anatomy, or nautical props. Use opaque gouache shapes with soft brush edges, paper texture, and restrained shading. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
